description: An XREFFILE that exists and holds no row: the only way to reach FILE STATUS '10' on the FIRST READ at :93, which drives the :98 arm, MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT at :99, the 88 APPL-EOF condition at :63 in its TRUE state and MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE at :108 before a single record has been displayed. The PERFORM UNTIL at :74 therefore runs exactly one iteration and the guard at :77 suppresses the :78 display, so the observable output is the two banners alone and nothing else. An empty dataset is a positive statement - the file was opened and read - and is not the same as a case that never mentioned the dataset.
